text:
alice: Heads-up — main pipeline turned red immediately after the merge from @carol (commit 9f2a7b). Failing jobs: integration-kvalloc-ubuntu, smoke-gpu. :eyes:

deploy-bot: [CI] integration-kvalloc-ubuntu failed on step 'kvalloc-alloc' — exit code 137. Logs: /ci/4265/kvalloc.log

ben: can you paste the failing log lines?

alice: here's the last 20 lines:
```
[ERROR] kvalloc: allocation failed: OOM after 1024MB
stage: kvalloc-alloc
stack: /src/alloc.c:421 kv_alloc
assertion failed: kv_cache_init()
```

carol: I didn't touch kvalloc code but I did change the docker layer caching logic in the build pipeline earlier today (layer cache key tweak). Rolling that back now? cc @ben

ben: Looks like an OOM in the test harness rather than a functional assert. Could be env or image change from the caching tweak. If rerun passes with higher mem we can avoid bisect.

alice: @oncall can you trigger a manual rerun of just integration-kvalloc-ubuntu? If it still fails we'll need a bisect across 9f2a7b..HEAD.

oncall: starting a manual rerun now (job id 4265-rr). Note: we're low on burst quota this window, so I'm only rerunning the failing job.

deploy-bot: Rerun started by oncall: https://ci.internal/4265-rr

(deploy-bot update after ~3m)
deploy-bot: Rerun complete — job failed again with same assertion and OOM trace. Artifact attached: https://ci.internal/artifacts/4265-rr/kvalloc.log

carol: on it. I'll try to reproduce locally: `./scripts/ci-run.sh integration-kvalloc --seed 42` — ETA ~8m. If I can repro I'll bisect.

ben: if you can reproduce, please run with `K_VMEM=2G` to check if it's just a memory regression. If that helps, we can pin a config change. If not, we'll need to `git bisect`.

alice: triage plan for now:
- carol: attempt local repro + quick bisect if repro succeeds
- ben: prep a bisect script `git bisect run ./scripts/test-kvalloc.sh` so we can automate
- oncall: hold autobumps and block canary until we have a fix or rollback :lock:

carol: repro confirmed locally, same OOM/assert. Starting bisect run now. Will ping with the suspect commit or if I need infra help.

oncall: holding autobumps and flagged the merge as blocked in the deploy dashboard. I also put a note in #incidents.

ben: if bisect identifies a non-obvious change, consider reverting the build cache tweak as a safe rollback; that was the largest non-code change in the window.

alice: agreed. If we can't have a short fix in 30m we should revert the merge that introduced 9f2a7b and run a hotfix.

carol: bisect found culprit: commit 3c4d1a (docker: use shared layer cache key for base image). Reverting that change locally fixes the test. Pushing a revert PR now.

alice: awesome — thanks @carol. @oncall can you coordinate a quick rollback/redeploy if CI fails after the revert PR merges? :thumbsup:

oncall: will do. I'll monitor and coordinate rollback if needed. Leaving the thread for updates.

alice: closing loop — revert PR opened and queued, we'll watch the pipeline and follow up in the incident thread. Thanks everyone.
